# This workflow will build a golang project
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-go

name: Go

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ]
  # Enables manual runs 
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: '1.20'
      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./...
      - name: Test
        run: go test -v ./...

FROM golang:1.15.0-buster as go-builder
WORKDIR /module
COPY . /module/
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 \
    go build -a -tags netgo \
      -ldflags '-w -extldflags "-static"' \
      -mod vendor \
      -o run-integration-tests

FROM alpine:latest as certs
RUN apk --update add ca-certificates

FROM scratch
COPY --from=go-builder /module/run-integration-tests .
COPY --from=certs /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
ENTRYPOINT ["/run-integration-tests"]

FROM golang:1.15.0-buster as go-builder
WORKDIR /module
COPY . /module/
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 \
    go build -a -tags netgo \
      -ldflags '-w -extldflags "-static"' \
      -mod vendor \
      -o run-integration-backend

FROM alpine:latest as certs
RUN apk --update add ca-certificates

FROM scratch
COPY --from=go-builder /module/run-integration-backend .
COPY --from=certs /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
ENTRYPOINT ["/run-integration-backend"]

FROM golang:1.22
WORKDIR /go/src/github.com/kelseyhightower/app/
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build .

FROM scratch
COPY --from=0 /go/src/github.com/kelseyhightower/app/helloworld .
ENTRYPOINT ["/helloworld"]

FROM golang:1.12beta1-stretch as builder
ENV GO111MODULE=on
WORKDIR /module
COPY . /module/
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 \
    go build -a -tags netgo \
      -ldflags '-w -extldflags "-static"' \
      -mod vendor \
      -o env

FROM alpine:latest as certs
RUN apk --update add ca-certificates

FROM scratch
COPY --from=builder /module/env .
COPY --from=certs /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
ENTRYPOINT ["/env"]

FROM golang:1.15.3-buster as go-builder
WORKDIR /module
COPY . /module/
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 \
    go build -a -tags netgo \
      -ldflags '-w -extldflags "-static"' \
      -mod vendor \
      -o opa-bq-connector

FROM alpine:latest as certs
RUN apk --update add ca-certificates

FROM scratch
COPY --from=go-builder /module/opa-bq-connector .
COPY --from=certs /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
ENTRYPOINT ["/opa-bq-connector"]

FROM debian:buster as builder
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y wget unzip
RUN wget -q https://releases.hashicorp.com/vault/1.7.1/vault_1.7.1_linux_amd64.zip
RUN unzip vault_1.7.1_linux_amd64.zip

FROM alpine:latest as certs
RUN apk --update add ca-certificates

FROM scratch
COPY --from=certs /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
COPY --from=builder /vault .
ENTRYPOINT ["/vault", "server", "-config", "/etc/vault/config.hcl"]

FROM scratch
MAINTAINER Kelsey Hightower <kelsey.hightower@gmail.com>
ADD scheduler /scheduler
ENTRYPOINT ["/scheduler"]

FROM golang:1.15.5-buster as go-builder
WORKDIR /module
COPY . /module/
ADD aws-lambda-rie /aws-lambda-rie
RUN mkdir -p /opt/extensions
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build

FROM scratch
COPY --from=go-builder /opt/extensions /opt/extensions
COPY --from=go-builder /aws-lambda-rie /aws-lambda-rie
COPY --from=go-builder /module/sum /sum
ENTRYPOINT ["/sum"]

FROM gcr.io/hightowerlabs/opa:0.24.0-dev

ADD config.yaml /config.yaml

ENTRYPOINT ["/opa"]
CMD ["run"]
